d:
She’s married to a cruel man… but her heart, and body, now belong to her seductive psychologist.
When gentle housewife Fiona seeks therapy, she finds more than comfort in the arms of Flora Tayumi, a dominant, alluring woman with plans of her own.
Torn between fear and forbidden passion, Fiona must decide: remain his wife… or become hers.
